from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial profit data from a single company report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    profit_label: str | None = Field(description="Label of the profit line item, e.g. '利润总额'")
    profit_amount_value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of the profit amount")
    profit_amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g. '元', '百万元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period of the financial statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet anchoring the data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    profit_records: list[FinancialProfitRecord]
